issue:
Turtle highlighting does not properly terminate on multi-line strings
See title. If a string has a newline character in it, it'll keep highlighting the rest of the file like the string keeps going.

Reproduction example: `curl https://health-ri.sandbox.semlab-leiden.nl/dataset/fdf426ca-0c23-4554-aee9-501e0bb61dae\?format\=ttl | pygmentize -l turtle`
